translations.web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
translations.bsb: Food may come from the earth, but from below it is transformed as by fire.
translations.kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
